job.title: Facilities Technician
job.description: Example Wafer Works is hiring a Facilities Technician to keep its fab's support systems running: process cooling water, vacuum and exhaust, gas cabinets and the PLC-controlled interlocks around them. Requirements: 3+ years maintaining industrial or semiconductor equipment; read electrical and P&ID drawings; lockout/tagout; on-call one weekend a month. You will report to the facilities maintenance manager.
